source.citation: Hendrycks et al., "CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review", 2021
source.note: A public SEC filing (sec.gov). Signature block names corporate officers, which is public record. No agreement date and no governing law are stated, so those fields are deliberately unverifiable.

effective_date.reason: Not stated. The document only gives a commencement date for maintenance.

end_date.reason: Not stated as a date. The term is described as one year from the commencement date, not printed as an end date.

governing_law.reason: Not stated. The agreement refers to a separate Master Agreement for its terms.
